query: Please implement an educational product teaching platform that includes user management, learning resource management, teaching plan and course design, courseware creation and sharing, homework and exam management, student learning tracking, interaction and discussion, and data analysis and reporting. Users can register, log in, log out, and maintain their information, while teachers can develop teaching plans, design courses, create and edit courseware, manage homework and exams, track student learning progress and performance, and engage in real-time communication with students. Select mint frost for layout background and seagreen for component details.
